pv10:1.1: Kā nu antovimānasmiṃ tiṭṭhantī n' upanikkhami upanikkhamassu bhadde tvaṃ passāma taṃ mahiddhikan ti. || ||
pv10:2.1: Aṭṭiyāmi harāyāmi naggā nikkhamituṃ bahi keseh' amhi paṭicchannā puññaṃ me appakaṃ katan ti. || ||
pv10:3.1: Hand' uttarīyaṃ dadāmi te imaṃ dussaṃ nivāsaya imaṃ dussaṃ nivasetvā bahi nikkhama sobhane, upanikkhamassu bhadde tvaṃ passāma tam bahiṭṭhitan ti. || ||
pv10:4.1: Hatthena hatthe te dinnaṃ na mayhaṃ upakappati es' etth' upāsako saddho sammāsambuddhasāvako, || ||
pv10:5.1: Etaṃ acchādayitvāna mama dakkhiṇam ādisa tathāhaṃ sukhitā hessaṃ sabbakāmasamiddhinī ti. || ||
pv10:6.1: Tañ ca te nhāpayitvāna vilimpetvāna vāṇijā vattheh' acchādayitvāna tassā dakkhiṇam ādisuṃ. || ||
pv10:7.1: Samanantarānuddiṭṭhe vipāko upapajjatha bhojanacchādanapānīyaṃ, dakkhiṇāya idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
pv10:8.1: Tato suddhā sucivasanā kāsikuttamadhārinī hasantī vimānā nikkhami dakkhiṇāya idaṃ phalan ti. || ||
pv10:9.1: Sucittarūpaṃ ruciraṃ vimānaṃ te pabhāsati devate pucchitācikkha kissa kammass' idaṃ phalan ti. || ||
pv10:10.1: Bhikkhuno caramānassa doṇinimmajjanaṃ ahaṃ adāsiṃ ujubhūtassa vippasannena cetasā. || ||
pv10:11.1: Tassa kammassa kusalassa vipākaṃ dīgham antaraṃ anubhomi vimānasmiṃ tañ ca dāni parittakaṃ. || ||
pv10:12.1: Uddhaṃ catūhi māsehi kālakiriyā bhavissati ekantaṃ kaṭukaṃ ghoraṃ nirayaṃ papatiss' ahaṃ. || ||
pv10:13.1: Catukkaṇṇaṃ catudvāraṃ vibhattaṃ bhāgaso mitaṃ ayopākārapariyantaṃ ayasā paṭikujjitaṃ. || ||
pv10:14.1: Tassa ayomayā bhūmi jalitā tejasā yutā samantā yojanasataṃ pharitvā tiṭṭhati sabbadā. || ||
pv10:15.1: Tatthāhaṃ dīgham addhānam dukkham vedissa vedanaṃ phalañ ca pāpakammassa tasmā socām' ahaṃ bhusan ti. || ||
